# Not MIT: OmniaUI Pro

The files in this folder (`pro.css`, `manifest.json`) and the Pro block scripts in `public/js` that start with the
"OmniaUI Pro" banner (`oc-barcode-maker.js`, `oc-data-table-pro.js`, `oc-ecosystem-map.js`, `oc-infinite-carousel.js`, `oc-network-graph.js`, `oc-product-picker.js`, `oc-shop.js`, `oc-spotlight.js`)
are copies of OmniaUI Pro. They are here only so omniaui.eu can show live previews of the Pro blocks.

They are **not** covered by the MIT license of this repository. They fall under the OmniaUI Pro license and may only
be used with a valid license: https://omniaui.eu/legal/pro-license. Buy a license at https://omniaui.eu/ui/pro.
